data.fixed_clause: The company reserves the right to process all applicant disclosures, including medical history, health conditions, and religious affiliations where provided, under the framework of legitimate human resources interest to support targeted corporate wellness initiatives and internal profiling. Advertising or awareness materials may only be sent to personal contact channels with the recipient's prior consent, and senders must provide a clear way to stop receiving them.
